name: prisma
description: Build and deploy your apps with Prisma.

interface.longDescription:
Take your app from idea to a live URL with Prisma. Prisma brings together app hosting with Prisma Compute, managed databases with Prisma Postgres, and type-safe data access with Prisma ORM.

Build a new app with Prisma Composer or get an existing app ready for Compute. The plugin guides you through setup, local testing, and deployment, then checks that your live app works.
defaultPrompt: Build a new app and deploy it
